definitions.gloss: to pour down; to shower down
definitions.explanation: to fall continuously and intensely from above, used for rain, sunlight, or other things that come down

examples.japanese: ⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}ぐ。
⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}いだ。
⟦{花火|はなび}→花火：00087_hanabi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{火|ひ}の{粉|こ}→火の粉：13430_hinoko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{夜空|よぞら}→夜空：09591_yozora⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}いで⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Sparks from the fireworks were showering down from the night sky.

notes:
{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}ぐ is a compound verb expressing something pouring or showering down from above.

VERB TYPE: Godan verb (u-verb), intransitive

WRITING:
- ⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧ (to fall - rain, snow)
- ⟦{注|そそ}ぐ→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧ (to pour)

COMMON SUBJECTS:
- ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}ぐ (rain pours down)
- ⟦{日差|ひざ}し→日差し：00107_hizashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}ぐ (sunlight showers down)
- ⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}ぐ (light pours down)
- ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}ぐ (snow showers down)

USAGE:
- ⟦{愛情|あいじょう}→愛情：01673_aijou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}ぐ (to shower with love) - transitive use
- ⟦{祝福|しゅくふく}→祝福：13733_shukufuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}ぐ (blessings rain down)
- Implies abundance and intensity
- Often poetic or descriptive
- Evokes imagery of things cascading from above
